label: copy-phase input of t/2/g/y/e (from 2nd copy step on), also generic 2nd copy step
explanation: Fires almost only during the copy phase (97% of mass), never at the delimiter or first copy step (recall_idx 0), and rarely at recall_idx 1. Strongly token-selective on the fed-back input: t (39% rate), 2 (27%), g, y, e; strongest activations are t or 2 fed back at recall_idx 2 (the second copied token being re-input). Separately there is a weaker position component: recall_idx 2 fires for many tokens (26% rate, 47% of mass), more in long sequences (L 8-9). Weak original-phase firing at t=1-2 (~3% of mass), mostly on t. Predicate gets dev F1 0.58, mass recall 0.76; misses are mostly other tokens at recall_idx 2; false positives are t/g/y/e copy inputs late in the sequence with no activation.
